protocol.name: dbmags_leave_replicate_paper_aligned_main_comparison_v6

scenario_generalization.reason: The registered leave-one-replicate-index-out protocol retains all 22 scenario identities in both training and evaluation partitions; it measures repeated-block diagnosis, not unseen-scenario transfer.

protocol.comparability: All evaluated methods use the same 660 cases, six outer folds, and root labels. OpDiag root detection uses frozen KPIs; DBAIOps derives its anomaly models and ExperienceGraph from the same training KPIs; EPDG-grounded rows additionally use integrity-bound anonymous SQL-shape evidence, while the complete HyperDBDiag row also includes constrained LLM arbitration.

multi_root_output_adapter.changes_to_opdiag_core: none; adapter changes only output cardinality

dbaiops.paper_reproduction: DBAIOps components instantiated from the outer training fold

anomaly_models.equation_representation: depth-6 entropy decision trees over multi-metric statistics
anomaly_models.frequency_control: at least 3 of 5 time bins beyond the training-fold dynamic baseline

experience_graph.evolution: metric proximity expansion followed by current abnormal-state clipping

root_cause_analyser.selection: training-fold learned root count followed by Top-k graph scores

stage.structure: broad hypergraph retrieval, local structured-evidence contraction, and symmetric relation-aware LLM arbitration enabled only for ECSA relations with stable positive training-fold OOF value

post_diagnosis_remediation.authority: post-diagnosis advice only; the root set is frozen
post_diagnosis_remediation.selection: deterministic round-robin by predicted root set; no truth labels

blinded_quality_review.reviewer_model_independence: same configured model in a separate blinded call
